description: Least-privilege capability set for the main window. It grants only the core default permissions (IPC to this app's own commands, receiving Rust-emitted events). No filesystem, shell, HTTP, dialog, or other plugin capability is granted, because every privileged operation in HiddenSteps goes through its own #[tauri::command]s and Rust-side APIs — the webview has no legitimate need to reach the OS directly, and this file makes that scope explicit rather than relying on implicit defaults.
